text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What a terrible breakout. I must 
be even more diligent about keeping a 
proper routine.

text_block_list.name: Apprentice Pastry Chef
text_block_list.text:
Royce! You always give me courage! I'm 
working hard for my dreams right now 
too... So I made this to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Wow, what lovely petit fours! And the 
attention to detail is amazing...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'll savor your 
heartfelt feelings to the fullest!

Because she cares so much about her fans, 
Royce and Royce continued to worry about 
her rough skin afterwards...
